title: Implement telemetry state with atomics and history fifo
description:
Create Source/Telemetry/TelemetryState.h and Source/Telemetry/TelemetryState.cpp, then publish into it from Source/PluginProcessor.h and Source/PluginProcessor.cpp.

TelemetryState is the ONLY channel between the audio thread and the GUI. It must contain:
1. Scalar latest-value telemetry as `std::atomic<float>` (and `std::atomic<bool>` for the safety flag): leftPeak, rightPeak, leftRms, rightRms, activity, density, sustain, contraction, bloom, correlation, safetyEngaged. Provide `setX(float)` writers using `std::memory_order_relaxed` (release only where a grouped snapshot is required) and `getX()` readers for the GUI.
2. A `juce::AbstractFifo` plus a fixed-size preallocated backing array of a POD struct `HistorySample { float onset; float density; float sustain; float gap; }` used ONLY for detector time-series history where overflow is acceptable. The FIFO is never authoritative for current meter values. Size the backing array as a compile-time constant (e.g. `static constexpr int historyCapacity = 1024;`) allocated as a `std::array`, never resized at runtime.
3. `pushHistory(const HistorySample&)` callable from the audio thread with no allocation, no locks, and no blocking: if there is no free space, drop the sample and return.
4. `int readHistory(HistorySample* dest, int maxSamples)` for the GUI timer.

Real-time rules are binding: nothing in TelemetryState called from processBlock may allocate, lock, construct a juce::String, or grow a buffer. All storage is allocated at construction or in a `prepare()` called from prepareToPlay.

In PluginProcessor: add a `TelemetryState telemetry;` member (or equivalent) with a public accessor `TelemetryState& getTelemetryState() noexcept`, call any `prepare()` from prepareToPlay, and publish the scalar values at the end of processBlock from values already computed by the DSP/analyzer. Do not add new DSP computation, do not change the processing chain, and keep `juce::ScopedNoDenormals` at the top of processBlock. Publication must be pure atomic stores.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.h and Source/PluginProcessor.cpp (existing members, prepareToPlay, processBlock structure, and the names of the analyzer/detector values already available)
- JUCE/modules/juce_core/containers/juce_AbstractFifo.h (exact prepareToWrite/finishedWrite/prepareToRead/finishedRead signatures in the vendored revision)
- Source/DSP or Source/Analysis headers for the existing analyzer output accessors, so publication reads existing values rather than recomputing them

Neither Source/Telemetry nor the GUI may include DSP headers, and DSP code may not include Telemetry headers other than PluginProcessor's own publication site.
acceptance_criteria: Source/Telemetry/TelemetryState.h declares class TelemetryState with std::atomic members for leftPeak, rightPeak, leftRms, rightRms, activity, density, sustain, contraction, bloom, correlation, and safetyEngaged
Source/Telemetry/TelemetryState.h declares a POD struct HistorySample and a juce::AbstractFifo with a fixed-size std::array backing store sized by a static constexpr capacity
pushHistory in Source/Telemetry/TelemetryState.cpp performs no heap allocation, takes no lock, and drops samples when the fifo is full
Source/PluginProcessor.h declares a TelemetryState member and a getTelemetryState() accessor returning a reference

Source/PluginProcessor.cpp publishes telemetry scalar values at the end of processBlock using atomic stores only, with no allocation, locks, juce::String construction, or GUI calls added inside processBlock
juce::ScopedNoDenormals remains the first statement of processBlock in Source/PluginProcessor.cpp
Source/Telemetry/TelemetryState.h and .cpp include no header from Source/GUI or Source/DSP
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add heap allocation, locks, file IO, string construction, or GUI calls inside processBlock
use std::atomic<std::shared_ptr> or place strings/metadata in audio-thread snapshots
resize the history fifo backing store at runtime
change the existing DSP processing chain, parameter layout, or bus layout logic

allowed: choose the history fifo capacity constant
choose relaxed versus release/acquire ordering per scalar
add private setters for individual telemetry scalars
forbidden: introduce a new cross-thread messaging framework
make the history fifo authoritative for meter values
add new DSP analysis computation in PluginProcessor
